name: selectionarm-random5-sameday30-20261007

protocol.top_k: omitted, original native generate endpoint default
protocol.design: Full-episode random-of-five: resample five actor candidates and independently pick a uniform candidate index at every step
protocol.historical_reference: ARM_SUMMARY first table: 30.0% baseline and42.7% SelectionARM
protocol.seed_realization: Independent stochastic repetition with an explicit distinct server RNG seed per shard. Per-request seeds remain logged but are not honored by the unchanged FlashInfer sampler; batch-independent reproducibility is not claimed.
protocol.comparability: Same300 tasks and actor/browser/decoding/judge as the concurrently collecting SFT/Piotr pair; later same-day collection, independent actor deployment. Random selection is uniform over sampled indices including duplicates and malformed candidates.

selection_algorithm: Independent task/turn PRNG stream; randrange(5), all indices retained including duplicate/malformed candidates. Pick after all five generated; never score with selector or execution outcome.
analysis: random5 versus fresh SFT, paired task bootstrap
Piotr SelectionARM versus random5, paired task bootstrap
invalid/candidate failure rates, tokens, latency, GPU and judge accounting
scientific_limitations: same-day independent browser collection; no identical-state or deterministic-prefix claim
same actor requests and eight-browser concurrency; one GPU and8CPUs per random shard versus actor+selector GPUs/16CPUs per paired shard; latency is operational rather than hardware-matched
